title: Safeguards for SCs and STs run through the Constitution
sources: SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989

quiz.q: Which Article directs the state to promote the educational and economic interests of SCs and STs?

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: The Constitution doesn't protect Scheduled Castes and Tribes in one place.
The safeguards are spread across it.

beats.say: The Constitution doesn't protect Scheduled Castes and Tribes in one place. The safeguards are spread across it.

lines.say: Articles 15(4) and 16(4) allow special provisions and job reservation. Article 46 asks the state to promote their interests.
Articles 330 and 332 reserve seats in legislatures.

items.sub: Promote their education and economic interests
Seats in Lok Sabha and assemblies

beats.say: Articles 15(4) and 16(4) allow special provisions and job reservation. Article 46 asks the state to promote their interests. Articles 330 and 332 reserve seats in legislatures.
